info.title: MTA API
info.description:
REST API for NYC MTA transit data — subway, LIRR, and Metro-North routes, stops, arrivals, vehicles, and service alerts.

This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or licensed by the MTA.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code for client branching. `INVALID_PARAM`: a query/path parameter failed validation (400). `NOT_FOUND`: the requested entity or route does not exist (404). `FEED_ERROR`: an upstream realtime feed was unavailable and no cache could be served (503). `RATE_LIMITED`: too many requests (429). `INTERNAL`: an unexpected server error (500).

transfer_type.description: 0 recommended, 1 timed (vehicle guaranteed to wait), 2 requires min_transfer_time, 3 not possible.

generated_at.description: Unix timestamp when the feed was generated

route_id.description: Internal GTFS route identifier. Not a display label — on LIRR and Metro-North it is an opaque number ("4" is the Ronkonkoma Branch). Use `route_name` when showing this to a user.

route_name.description: Rider-facing name for the route: the subway bullet ("A", "7") or the commuter-rail branch ("Ronkonkoma Branch"). Never empty — falls back to `route_id` if the schedule names no route.

route_long_name.description: Longer route name where one exists, otherwise the same value as `route_name`.

arrival_time.description: Unix timestamp of arrival, or null for departure-only updates

departure_time.description: Unix timestamp of departure, or null if not published

delay_seconds.description: Seconds late (positive) or early (negative); null if not published

destination_stop_id.description: The trip's true terminus - the last stop time update in the feed

direction.description: Compass direction at this station, from the matched platform suffix. Subway only.

direction_id.description: Branch-relative direction as published by LIRR - not a compass direction. LIRR only.

status.description: Vehicle status, or null if this feed doesn't publish it for this trip

route_id.description: Internal GTFS route identifier. Not a display label — on LIRR and Metro-North it is an opaque number ("4" is the Ronkonkoma Branch). Use `route_name` when showing this to a user.

route_name.description: Rider-facing name for the route: the subway bullet ("A", "7") or the commuter-rail branch ("Ronkonkoma Branch"). Never empty — falls back to `route_id` if the schedule names no route.

route_long_name.description: Longer route name where one exists, otherwise the same value as `route_name`.

informed_entities.description: Per-entry impact selectors preserving the (route, stop, direction) pairing from the upstream feed.

direction_id.description: Affected direction of travel: 0 = Northbound, 1 = Southbound. Omitted when impact applies to both directions.

service_dates.description: The service dates actually queried, in query order.

next_after.description: Cursor for the next page (unix seconds), or null on a non-full page.

route_id.description: Internal GTFS route identifier. Not a display label — on LIRR and Metro-North it is an opaque number ("4" is the Ronkonkoma Branch). Use `route_name` when showing this to a user.

route_name.description: Rider-facing name for the route: the subway bullet ("A", "7") or the commuter-rail branch ("Ronkonkoma Branch"). Never empty — falls back to `route_id` if the schedule names no route.

route_long_name.description: Longer route name where one exists, otherwise the same value as `route_name`.

service_date.description: YYYYMMDD service date this row's timestamps were computed against.

arrival_time.description: Raw GTFS HH:MM:SS, or null if this stop_time has no arrival.

arrival_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp, or null only when arrival_time is null.

train_number.description: LIRR/MNR train number (trip_short_name); null on subway.

direction_id.description: Static GTFS direction_id, as published - not derived or inferred.

peak.description: LIRR/MNR fare period; null on subway, which has no such concept.

duration_seconds.description: Seconds between this departure and the arrival at `to`.

ScheduledDepartureDestination.description: Where this trip reaches the requested `to` stop, including duration_seconds.

resolved_trip_id.description: The static trip_id this response actually describes - equals `trip_id` unless `matched_by` is `rt_trip_id_suffix`.

route_id.description: Internal GTFS route identifier. Not a display label — on LIRR and Metro-North it is an opaque number ("4" is the Ronkonkoma Branch). Use `route_name` when showing this to a user.

route_name.description: Rider-facing name for the route: the subway bullet ("A", "7") or the commuter-rail branch ("Ronkonkoma Branch"). Never empty — falls back to `route_id` if the schedule names no route.

route_long_name.description: Longer route name where one exists, otherwise the same value as `route_name`.

service_date.description: YYYYMMDD service date timestamps were computed against, or null when no candidate date had this trip's service active - every stop's *_timestamp is then also null, but *_time (raw HH:MM:SS) is still populated.

get.description: Returns server status and per-feed static data counts and sync timestamps.

get.summary: Get scheduled trips between two stations
get.description: Returns scheduled trips from `from` to `to`, sourced from the static GTFS timetable (not realtime). Every departure reaches `to` later in its trip and carries a `destination` block with the arrival time there and duration_seconds. Unlike /arrivals, results are unaffected by feed outages and extend arbitrarily far into the future. For single-station departures right now, use /arrivals instead.

schema.description: Unix seconds cursor - only departures at or after this instant are returned. Defaults to now, or the start of `date` if `date` is given without `after`.

parameters.description: Unix seconds cursor - only departures at or after this instant are returned. Defaults to now, or the start of `date` if `date` is given without `after`.

get.summary: Get the static schedule for a trip
get.description: Resolves a trip_id - typically read off /arrivals or /schedule - to its full static stop-by-stop timetable. LIRR trip IDs must match exactly. Subway realtime trip IDs are frequently a suffix of the static ID and are resolved via a fallback match narrowed to the active service window. Metro-North realtime trip IDs cannot be resolved to a static trip at all - the two ID schemes are unrelated for that feed, so /arrivals-sourced MNR trip IDs will 404 here.

schema.description: Trip ID, as returned by /arrivals or /schedule

parameters.description: Trip ID, as returned by /arrivals or /schedule
parameters.name: trip_id

schema.description: YYYYMMDD service date to compute timestamps against. Defaults to the first of [yesterday, today, tomorrow] the trip's service is active on; if none are, timestamps are null and raw HH:MM:SS times are returned instead.

parameters.description: YYYYMMDD service date to compute timestamps against. Defaults to the first of [yesterday, today, tomorrow] the trip's service is active on; if none are, timestamps are null and raw HH:MM:SS times are returned instead.
parameters.name: date
